description: Rise in loan defaults among small business borrowers
mitigation: Tighten credit scoring, review exposure limits, and increase monitoring of high-risk accounts

description: Sharp fall in bond prices due to interest rate hike
mitigation: Hedge with interest rate swaps, diversify the portfolio, and review value-at-risk limits

description: Customers reported fraudulent card transactions overseas
mitigation: Block affected cards, enable real-time fraud alerts, and strengthen transaction monitoring rules

description: Core banking system outage during month-end processing
mitigation: Activate the disaster recovery site, inform customers, and run a root cause analysis

description: Delay in meeting a regulatory reporting deadline
mitigation: Escalate to the compliance head, request an extension, and automate report generation

description: Liquidity ratio dropped below the internal threshold
mitigation: Arrange short-term funding, reduce illiquid holdings, and review cash flow forecasts daily

description: Phishing attack targeted employees and exposed credentials
mitigation: Reset affected passwords, enforce multi-factor authentication, and run staff awareness training

description: Anti-money laundering alerts not reviewed within the SLA
mitigation: Add analysts to the review team, prioritise high-risk alerts, and tune alert thresholds

description: Third-party payment vendor failed a security audit
mitigation: Demand a remediation plan, limit data sharing, and identify an alternate vendor

description: Currency exchange rate volatility affecting foreign exposure
mitigation: Use forward contracts, set exposure limits per currency, and review the hedging strategy

description: Data migration to the new loan system lost customer records
mitigation: Restore from backup, validate record counts, and pause cutover until reconciliation is complete

description: Credit rating of a major corporate borrower was downgraded
mitigation: Re-assess collateral, reduce further exposure, and increase provisioning

description: Mortgage portfolio showing higher delinquency after a rate rise
mitigation: Offer restructuring options, review loan-to-value limits, and stress test the portfolio

description: Credit card delinquency increasing among young borrowers
mitigation: Tighten approval rules, lower initial limits, and send early payment reminders

description: Concentration of loans in one industry sector
mitigation: Set sector exposure limits, diversify lending, and review the portfolio quarterly

description: Equity portfolio losses during a stock market crash
mitigation: Rebalance the portfolio, use stop-loss rules, and apply hedging instruments

description: Commodity price swings affecting hedged positions
mitigation: Review hedge ratios, use options for protection, and monitor positions daily

description: Interest rate mismatch between assets and liabilities
mitigation: Run gap analysis, adjust the duration of assets, and use interest rate swaps

description: Unauthorized access to customer accounts through stolen passwords
mitigation: Force password resets, add multi-factor authentication, and monitor suspicious logins

description: Fake loan applications using forged documents
mitigation: Add document verification checks, cross-check with credit bureaus, and train underwriters

description: Insider employee manipulated transaction records
mitigation: Suspend access, start an internal investigation, and enforce segregation of duties

description: ATM skimming devices found at several branches
mitigation: Inspect all ATMs, install anti-skimming hardware, and alert affected customers

description: Payment gateway failed during peak festival sales
mitigation: Add a backup gateway, scale capacity before peak days, and set up failover alerts

description: Manual errors in daily reconciliation of accounts
mitigation: Automate reconciliation, add maker-checker approval, and track error rates

description: Key relationship manager resigned with client knowledge not documented
mitigation: Document client handovers, cross-train team members, and start succession planning

description: Branch operations disrupted by flooding
mitigation: Activate the business continuity plan, move staff to alternate sites, and review insurance cover

description: Failure to submit suspicious transaction reports on time
mitigation: Escalate to the compliance officer, file the reports immediately, and automate reporting reminders

description: New data privacy regulation requires changes in customer data handling
mitigation: Map customer data flows, update consent processes, and train staff on the new rules

description: Know-your-customer records incomplete for many accounts
mitigation: Run a KYC refresh drive, restrict accounts that stay incomplete, and track completion weekly

description: Audit found weak controls in loan approval workflow
mitigation: Prepare a corrective action plan, add approval checkpoints, and track closure of findings

description: Deposit withdrawals rising sharply after negative news
mitigation: Communicate with customers, keep liquid reserves ready, and access emergency funding lines

description: Funding costs increasing as short-term borrowing becomes expensive
mitigation: Diversify funding sources, extend borrowing maturities, and review pricing

description: Ransomware attack encrypted servers in the data center
mitigation: Isolate infected systems, restore from clean backups, and notify the regulator

description: Customer data exposed through a misconfigured cloud storage bucket
mitigation: Lock down access, review cloud configurations, and inform affected customers

description: Outdated software with known security vulnerabilities in production
mitigation: Apply patches, run vulnerability scans, and set up a patch management schedule

description: Cloud service provider outage affected online banking
mitigation: Switch to the backup region, review the provider SLA, and plan multi-cloud resilience

description: Outsourced call center mishandled sensitive customer data
mitigation: Audit the vendor, tighten data access controls, and add penalty clauses to the contract

description: Core banking upgrade project delayed by three months
mitigation: Re-plan milestones, add resources to critical tasks, and report the delay to stakeholders

description: Budget overrun in digital banking app development
mitigation: Review scope, apply change control, and set up monthly budget tracking

description: Scope keeps changing after requirements sign-off in the loan system project
mitigation: Introduce a formal change request process and get written approvals for every change
